title: kb.claims.changed
description: Sent by the KB to this repository as a GitHub repository_dispatch client_payload, event_type 'kb-claims-changed'. Arrival does not change the specification. It triggers a drift check, and a maintainer decides.

manifest_url.description: Where to fetch the full claim manifest. Overrides the KB_MANIFEST_URL secret for this run.

status.description: A claim that leaves 'accepted' invalidates any prose resting on it, whether or not the text changed.
